beats.name: OUT OF THE FACILITY
cap: Pat comes home after eight months; Nikki
has a restraining order and he has a plan
beats.tag: OPENING — a man rebuilding on a broken plan

beats.name: CLIFF'S OFFICE
cap: His therapist Cliff wants him back on the
medication; Pat insists that he is fine
beats.tag: ROUTINE — the help he keeps refusing

beats.name: DINNER AT RONNIE'S
cap: At his best friend's dinner Pat meets
Tiffany, a widow, and they swap diagnoses

beats.name: THE DEAL
cap: Tiffany offers to carry letters to Nikki if
Pat trains with her for a dance contest
beats.tag: THE DEAL — a favour that is really a bet

beats.name: THE STUDIO
cap: They rehearse the routine after hours; he
reads Nikki's letters and starts to change
beats.tag: TRAINING — the two of them, getting better

beats.name: DANNY TURNS UP
cap: Danny, his friend from the ward, shows up
at the house and pushes him to keep going
beats.tag: BEST FRIEND — the one who got out first

beats.name: PAT SR.'S PARLAY
cap: Pat's father bets the family money on the
Eagles and on his son's dance score
beats.tag: SUBPLOT — the father's superstition and debt

beats.name: THE SUNDAY BLOW-UP
cap: Game day ends in shouting between Pat and
his father; Tiffany walks out of the house
beats.tag: FIGHT — everyone convinced they are right

beats.name: THE LETTER
cap: Cliff points out that the letter signed by
Nikki is Tiffany's handwriting and work
beats.tag: REVEAL — the letters were Tiffany's all along

beats.name: PAT RUNS
cap: Pat runs through the streets looking for
Tiffany, who has gone missing since the row
beats.tag: GESTURE — the first thing he has chased

beats.name: FIVE POINTS
cap: They perform the routine; the judges hold
up a 5, and the parlay comes down to it
beats.tag: CLIMAX — the number that settles the bet

beats.name: THE SILVER LINING
cap: Pat stops trying to win Nikki back and
stays with Tiffany; the bet pays off
beats.tag: ENDING — the silver lining chosen out loud
